# #3283: Patch: the fuzz starts games the way a dungeon fight does: cards dealt Radiant or Buffed, a hero's health and Armor set, decks of other sizes
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Every dungeon fight starts its game in ways the online and practice games never do:
- some cards in the player's deck begin Radiant or with Buffs;
- the hero starts at the run's health, which may be low, or above the usual 30 once a relic raises it, and may start with Armor;
- either side may open with extra cards or mana;
- a deck can be smaller or larger than 25.

The checker that plays thousands of random games and checks the rules after every step never starts a game like that. A rules bug that only shows from such a start would reach dungeon players unseen.

Once this is built, a share of the checker's games start like a dungeon fight and go through all the same checks. Its report also names the Radiant faces no game ever played.

## Why

- `CreateGameOptions.deck_marks` (`crates/engine/src/state.rs:2154-2159`, R2702000) deals cards Radiant or Buffed at setup.
- `run_fight_setup` (`crates/run/src/fight.rs:117-170`) also sets:
  - the human's `hero_health` to the run's HP and the enemy's to its own;
  - Armor, opening cards and crystals from Combat relics and curses (R2922001, R181, R182, R2922000);
  - deck sizes from the run's own deck.
- `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs` sets none of these: `deck_marks`, `hero_health` and `hero_armor` do not appear in it. `handicap_for_seed` (`fuzz.rs:3117-3133`) only rotates `AI_DIFFICULTY`'s Medium and Hard, whose `hero_health` and `hero_armor` are `None`.
- The only code that plays these setups is `run-sim` (`crates/tools/src/run_sim.rs`). It plays AI against AI with no invariant monitor: `PR_FIGHTS` fights per pull request and `DAILY_SEEDS` runs a day. The monitor's only callers are `fuzz.rs`, `duos_fuzz.rs` and `fused_pairs.rs`.
- The coverage line (#2426) counts card ids (`note_played`, `fuzz.rs:2367`), so a Radiant face that never resolved does not show, though `cardResolved` already carries `radiant`.
- This is not #1693's combination of dealt seats, last boards and Glitch boards. Those inputs are already fuzzed, while these are fuzzed by no monitored game at all.

## Proposal

- On a share of seeds in both 1v1 waves (`RUN_START_SHARE`, strawman 0.15), the fuzz draws a dungeon-style setup from a stream of its own, so no existing seed's game moves. The setup holds:
  - deck marks on some cards of each deck: Radiant, and Buffs up to a small bound;
  - a hero health from low to above the usual starting health, and some starting Armor;
  - extra opening cards and crystals within the bounds the run's own effects reach;
  - a deck size other than `DECK_SIZE`, within the handicap's legal range.
- The setup goes to the fold, so the replay hash check folds it too. `FoldArgs` already carries `deck_marks` and `handicaps`.
- The summary's `starts:` line and `--json`'s `starts` count these games. A failure prints the marks and handicaps, and `--from N --seeds 1` replays them.
- The `coverage:` line adds the Radiant faces of dealt pool cards that no game resolved, read from `cardResolved`'s `radiant`. It never fails a seed.
- New numbers are named constants beside `START_STATE_SHARE`. Run bounds are read from the run crate's config where one exists.

## Where it lands

- `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs` and its tests.
- The fuzz row of `crates/tools/README.md`.
- `crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs`, only if a monitor check assumes a hero starts at the standard health.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] On `RUN_START_SHARE` of seeds a game starts with deck marks and a run-style handicap. A unit test shows that such a seed's start is the same on every run, and that every seed outside the share deals exactly as before.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200` passes with the new starts, and the summary counts them.
- [ ] `--from N --seeds 1` replays such a seed with its marks and handicap.
- [ ] The coverage line and `--json` name the Radiant faces no game resolved.
- [ ] The tools README row describes the new starts.

## Size and risks

Medium, mostly `fuzz.rs`, 2 to 3 files. The seed count is unchanged, so CI time stays the same.

Risks:
- It may find real bugs, which then need fixing before it can merge. That is its point, and each one becomes its own issue.
- A Glitch reset re-deals marked Buffs (R2702000), so the builder decides whether a Glitch start and a run start may share a seed, and says so.

## Plan

_Written by `claude-1` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42183685759)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

`cargo jackioh fuzz`, in both 1v1 waves, starts a share of its games the way a dungeon fight does (`run_fight_setup`, R2702000, R2922000, R2922001). Those games get deck marks (some cards dealt Radiant or Buffed), a drawn hero health and Armor, extra opening cards and crystals, and decks of 10 to 60 cards. They go through every existing check, and the fold and checkpoint take the same inputs.

- **Share and stability:** `RUN_START_SHARE = 0.15` of seeds start this way. Every other seed starts exactly as before.
- **Counts and replay:** the summary's `starts:` line and `--json`'s `starts` count the new start as `run`. A failure prints its handicaps and marks. `--from N --seeds 1` replays the seed unchanged, because everything is drawn from the seed.
- **Coverage:** the coverage output and `--json` name the dealt pool cards whose Radiant face no game resolved (`cardResolved` with `radiant: true`). This never fails a seed.
- **README:** the tools README row describes all of it.

## Files to touch

| File | | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs` | change | New constants beside `START_STATE_SHARE`. `StartKind::Run`. `with_drawn_start`, `GameSetup::decks`, `create_options` and `fold_args`. New `run_start_inputs`, `run_start_note` and `note_radiant`. `GameRun.radiant`. `Coverage` radiant members. `report`, `Wave::summary` and `Wave::json`. Module docs. Tests (in the same file). |
| `crates/tools/README.md` | change | Two edits inside the `fuzz` row (line 15), described in step 13. |

**Do not touch:**
- `crates/engine`, `crates/cards`, `crates/ai`, `crates/run` (they stay pure, and tools only reads their constants).
- `crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs`. I checked: it assumes no starting health, deck size or Armor.
- `crates/tools/Cargo.toml` (`jackioh-run` is already a dependency).
- `spec/` (no ruling, no pending fragment, no catalog change).
- `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`.

Prior fuzz patches #3157 and #3172 changed only tools files and the README. This one is the same kind of patch.

## Steps

All edits are in `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs` unless stated. Line numbers are at base `03900c9783`.

1. **Imports** (lines 130–154).
   - Add `DeckMark`, `HUMAN_HANDICAP` and `LIBRARY_CAP`-free items only: `DeckMark`, `HUMAN_HANDICAP` to the `jackioh_engine::{…}` list.
   - Add `use jackioh_run::config::{RUN_ARTIFACT_LEVEL_MAX, RUN_DECK_MAX, RUN_ENEMY_HEALTH, RUN_STARTER_SIZE};`.

2. **Constants**, right after `START_STATE_SHARE` (line 681). Write each with a doc comment naming its source.
   - `pub const RUN_START_SHARE: f64 = 0.15;` Doc: a strawman, drawn from its own `run-start-` stream.
   - `const RUN_START_DECK_MIN: i32 = RUN_STARTER_SIZE as i32;` Doc: a run's starting deck.
   - `const RUN_START_DECK_MAX: i32 = RUN_DECK_MAX as i32;` Doc: the engine's library cap.
   - `const RUN_START_HERO_HEALTH_MAX: i32 = RUN_ENEMY_HEALTH.boss;` Doc: the final boss's health, the highest a run starts a hero at. The lowest is 1.
   - `const RUN_START_EFFECT_AMOUNT: i32 = 2;` Doc: the largest amount any placeholder fight effect carries.
   - `const RUN_START_ARMOR_MAX: i32 = RUN_START_EFFECT_AMOUNT * RUN_ARTIFACT_LEVEL_MAX;`
   - `const RUN_START_OPENING_MAX: i32 = RUN_START_EFFECT_AMOUNT * RUN_ARTIFACT_LEVEL_MAX;`
   - `const RUN_START_MANA_MAX: i32 = 3;` Doc: the placeholder content's three curses at +1 each.
   - `const RUN_START_BUFFS_MAX: i32 = 3;`
   - `const RUN_START_MARK_CHANCE: f64 = 0.3;` Doc: per card of a deck.

3. **`StartKind`** (lines 644–673).
   - Add the variant `Run`, documented as "what a dungeon fight starts from (#3283): marks and a run's handicaps, no boards".
   - Add `StartKind::Run => "run"` to `as_str`.
   - Make `START_KINDS` `[StartKind; 5]` with `StartKind::Run` last.
   - Leave `DRAWN_STARTS` at three. It lists only the old draw.

4. **`GameSetup::with_drawn_start`** (line 941). Put this before the existing body, which stays byte-for-byte:
   ```rust
   if Rng::new(&self.stream("run-start-"), 0).chance(RUN_START_SHARE) {
       return GameSetup { start: StartKind::Run, ..self };
   }
   ```
   A seed outside the share draws the old `start-` stream exactly as before. A Run seed no longer draws dealt, last-boards or glitch-boards. A dungeon fight has none of them, and this also settles the Glitch question in the issue (see Open questions).

5. **`GameSetup::decks`**, new, next to `handicaps()`.
   ```rust
   fn decks(&self, forced: usize) -> (Vec<String>, Vec<String>)
   ```
   - For `StartKind::Run`:
     - `let mut rng = Rng::new(&self.stream("run-start-decks-"), 0);`
     - Draw each size with a small private fn `run_deck_size(rng: &mut Rng, forced: usize) -> usize`: `(RUN_START_DECK_MIN + rng.int(RUN_START_DECK_MAX - RUN_START_DECK_MIN + 1))`, then `.max(forced)` and `.min(RUN_START_DECK_MAX)`, converted with `usize::try_from(..).unwrap_or(0)`. p1 first, then p2.
     - The `forced` floor keeps `--cards` and the changed-cards wave whole, since forced cards sit first in a deck (`force_into`).
     - Then `let mut shuffled = rng.shuffle(FUZZ_POOL.as_slice()).into_iter();` and return `(deal_deck(&mut shuffled, first), deal_deck(&mut shuffled, second))`.
   - Otherwise:
     - `Some(SeedHandicap { seat, handicap, .. }) = self.rotation` gives `handicap_decks_for_seed(self.seed, seat, &handicap)`.
     - `None` gives `decks_for_seed(self.seed)`.

6. **`fuzz_seed` and `fuzz_handicap_seed`** (lines 2502, 2519). Replace the deck argument to `forcing.play`:
   - `fuzz_seed`: `GameSetup::gate(seed).decks(forcing.for_seed(seed).len())`.
   - `fuzz_handicap_seed`: `GameSetup::handicapped(seed).decks(forcing.for_seed(seed).len())`. Drop its now-unused destructuring of `handicap_for_seed`.
   - Leave `fuzz_deal*`, `run_seed` and the corpus replay alone. They take decks as given, so tests that plant cards still work.

7. **`run_start_inputs`**, new free fn near `manufactured_board`.
   ```rust
   fn run_start_inputs(
       rng: &mut Rng,
       base: Option<PerPlayerOpt<Handicap>>,
       decks: &(Vec<String>, Vec<String>),
   ) -> (PerPlayerOpt<Handicap>, PerPlayerOpt<Vec<DeckMark>>)
   ```
   For `(P1, &decks.0)` then `(P2, &decks.1)`, in this fixed order:
   - Start from `handicap = base.get(player).copied().unwrap_or(HUMAN_HANDICAP)`. This layers the run on the handicapped wave's tier for its rotated seat.
   - `handicap.deck_size = i32::try_from(deck.len()).unwrap_or(i32::MAX)`.
   - `hero_health = Some(1 + rng.int(RUN_START_HERO_HEALTH_MAX))`.
   - `armor = rng.int(RUN_START_ARMOR_MAX + 1)`, then `hero_armor = (armor > 0).then_some(armor)`.
   - `extra_opening_cards += rng.int(RUN_START_OPENING_MAX + 1)`.
   - `mana = rng.int(RUN_START_MANA_MAX + 1)`, added to both `mana_bonus` and `mana_cap` (R181, as `EnemyMana` does).
   - Marks: for each index `0..deck.len()`, `if rng.chance(RUN_START_MARK_CHANCE)` draw `radiant = rng.coin()` and `upgrades = rng.int(RUN_START_BUFFS_MAX + 1)`. Push `DeckMark { index, radiant, upgrades }` only if `radiant || upgrades > 0`.
   - Store with `*handicaps.slot(player) = Some(handicap)` and `*marks.slot(player) = Some(list)`.

8. **`create_options`** (line 978).
   - Add the arm:
     ```rust
     StartKind::Run => {
         let (handicaps, marks) = run_start_inputs(&mut rng, options.handicaps.take(), &options.decks);
         options.handicaps = Some(handicaps);
         options.deck_marks = Some(marks);
     }
     ```
   - Update the method's doc to mention the marks.
   - Leave `handicaps()` (rotation only) unchanged, so `a_game_setup_names_the_streams…` still holds.

9. **`fold_args`** (line 1001). Add `deck_marks` to the destructured `CreateGameOptions` and to the `FoldArgs { … }` literal. Without it, replay and checkpoint would not deal the marks.

10. **Coverage.**
    - `GameRun` (line 862): add `radiant: IndexSet<String>`, documented as the def ids that resolved on their Radiant face. In `play_game`:
      - declare `let mut radiant: IndexSet<String> = IndexSet::new();`;
      - call `note_radiant(&mut radiant, &begun.events)` beside the first `note_played` (line 1061);
      - call it with `&result.events` beside the second (line 1235);
      - add `radiant` to the returned `GameRun`.
    - New fn beside `note_played`:
      ```rust
      fn note_radiant(radiant: &mut IndexSet<String>, events: &[GameEvent]) {
          for event in events {
              if let GameEvent::CardResolved { def_id, radiant: Some(true), .. } = event {
                  radiant.insert(def_id.clone());
              }
          }
      }
      ```
    - `Coverage` (line 2382): add `radiant: IndexSet<String>`. `of_game` keeps its signature, so its test callers don't change. Add `fn with_radiant(self, radiant: IndexSet<String>) -> Coverage { Coverage { radiant, ..self } }`.
    - `merge` extends `radiant`.
    - In `run_seed` (line 2562) use `Coverage::of_game(&run.decks, run.played).with_radiant(run.radiant)`.
    - Add `fn never_radiant(&self) -> Vec<&str>`: the dealt ids not in `radiant`, sorted with `sort_unstable`.
    - Extract the "first `COVERAGE_SHOWN` ids, then `… (+N more)`, else `none`" text from `line()` into a private helper. `line()`'s output must stay byte-identical, and its existing test guards that. Use the helper in `line()` and in the new `radiant_line()`.
    - `fn radiant_line(&self) -> String` returns `"  coverage (Radiant faces): {n} of {dealt} dealt pool cards never resolved Radiant: {shown}\n"`. `{n}` is `never_radiant().len()` and `{dealt}` is `dealt.len()`.
    - `json()` adds `"radiantResolved": dealt.len() - never_radiant().len()` and `"neverRadiant": never_radiant()`.
    - `Wave::summary` (line 2791): `text.push_str(&self.coverage.radiant_line());` right after `self.coverage.line()`.

11. **Failure output** (no new field on `Failure`).
    - New fn `run_start_note(failure: &Failure) -> Option<(Value, Value)>`:
      - return `None` unless `failure.start == StartKind::Run`;
      - otherwise `let setup = if failure.rotation.is_some() { GameSetup::handicapped(failure.seed) } else { GameSetup::gate(failure.seed) };`;
      - `let options = setup.create_options((*failure.decks).clone());`;
      - return `Some((json!(options.handicaps), json!(options.deck_marks)))`.
    - In `report`, after the `start:` line (line 2281): `if let Some((handicaps, marks)) = run_start_note(first)` pushes `"  handicaps: {handicaps}"` and `"  marks: {marks}"`.
    - In `Wave::json`'s failure object add `"handicaps"` and `"marks"` (`null` unless Run). Match the macro's existing style.

12. **Module docs.** Add a section `# Dungeon-fight starts (#3283)` after "Starting states". It covers the share, the checked-first stream, the deck, handicap and marks draws, that a Run seed has no boards, and that the replay takes the same inputs. Add one sentence to "Pool coverage" about the Radiant line.

13. **`crates/tools/README.md`**, two `Edit`s inside line 15, each on a unique substring.
    - Old: ``drawn from the seed alone so `--from` replays it, and the summary's `starts:` line and `--json`'s `starts` count each (#1503);``. Keep it and append the new clause. It says: on `RUN_START_SHARE` of seeds, checked first from a stream of its own so every other seed starts as before, a game starts as a dungeon fight does (#3283). That means decks of `RUN_START_DECK_MIN` to `RUN_START_DECK_MAX` cards (a `--cards` list kept whole), each hero at a drawn health up to `RUN_START_HERO_HEALTH_MAX` with drawn Armor, extra opening cards and crystals (layered on the handicapped wave's tier), and `deckMarks` dealing cards Radiant or Buffed up to `RUN_START_BUFFS_MAX` times (R2702000, R2922000, R2922001). It is counted as `run`. A failure prints `handicaps:` and `marks:` (`--json` too), and the fold, replay hash and checkpoint take the same inputs.
    - Old: `it never fails a seed, and played is not every hook run (a played card's Death or trigger may never have fired).` Append: a second line, `coverage (Radiant faces):`, counts the dealt pool cards no game resolved on their Radiant face (no `cardResolved` with `radiant: true`), and `--json`'s `coverage` adds `radiantResolved` and `neverRadiant`. It never fails a seed either.

## Tests

All new tests go in `fuzz.rs`'s `mod tests`, in a new `mod fuzz_run_starts { use super::*; … }` placed after `fuzz_starting_states`. Reuse `CI_SEEDS = 200` (redeclare it locally). Call `register_all()` and hold `let _preview = preview_every_set();` where a test builds a game or validates a setup.

**New tests**

1. `the_run_start_is_drawn_for_a_share_of_seeds_and_every_other_seed_starts_as_before`.
   - For seeds `1..=20`, assert each wave's start names equal these literals. I computed them with a Python copy of the engine's `Rng`, checked against its golden vectors in `rng.rs`.
     - Gate: `plain, glitch-boards, last-boards, plain, glitch-boards, run, run, dealt, plain, plain, dealt, dealt, plain, run, last-boards, glitch-boards, dealt, plain, glitch-boards, dealt`.
     - Handicapped: `plain, dealt, dealt, glitch-boards, dealt, dealt, dealt, plain, run, last-boards, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, glitch-boards, last-boards, plain, plain, plain`.
   - Over `1..=200`, assert the Run count is `> 0.5 * 200 * RUN_START_SHARE` and `< 1.5 * 200 * RUN_START_SHARE` in each wave (my values: 31 and 27).
   - Assert `GameSetup::plain(s).start == StartKind::Plain`.

2. `a_seed_outside_the_share_deals_its_decks_and_options_exactly_as_before`. For each wave and each seed in `1..=200` whose start is not Run:
   - `setup.decks(0)` equals `decks_for_seed(seed)` (gate), or `handicap_decks_for_seed(seed, seat, &handicap)` from `handicap_for_seed(seed)` (handicapped);
   - `create_options(decks).deck_marks.is_none()`;
   - `.handicaps == setup.handicaps()`.

3. `a_run_start_is_the_same_on_every_call_and_the_engine_takes_it`. For every Run seed in `1..=200`, in both waves:
   - `decks(0)` twice are equal, and `create_options` twice are equal.
   - Each deck's length is in `RUN_START_DECK_MIN..=RUN_START_DECK_MAX`, and across the seeds at least one deck's length is not `DECK_SIZE`.
   - Both seats have a handicap with `deck_size == deck.len()`, `hero_health` in `1..=RUN_START_HERO_HEALTH_MAX`, and `hero_armor` of `None` or in `1..=RUN_START_ARMOR_MAX`.
   - Each mark has `index < deck.len()`, `radiant || upgrades > 0`, and `upgrades <= RUN_START_BUFFS_MAX`.
   - `validate_setup(&options, &CATALOG, SetupKind::New)` is `Ok`. Add `SetupKind` and `validate_setup` to the test's imports.
   - `fold_args(decks, vec![])` has `handicaps` and `deck_marks` equal to the options'.
   - `decks(n)` with `n` set to 25 holds at least 25 cards in each deck (the `--cards` floor).

4. `a_run_start_game_plays_monitor_clean_and_folds_back_to_its_live_hash`. For the first Run seed of each wave, call `fuzz_seed` or `fuzz_handicap_seed` with `Forcing::default()` twice.
   - Both are `Ok` and `start == StartKind::Run`.
   - The two `hash`es are equal, so the start is the same on every run.
   - The hash differs from `GameSetup::plain(seed)` played over `decks_for_seed(seed)`.

5. `a_run_seed_played_alone_is_counted_as_run_in_the_summary_and_the_json`. `play_wave(seed, 1, &Forcing::default())` (and `play_handicap_wave`) for the first Run seed:
   - `failures.is_empty()`;
   - `start_counts()` is `1` for `run` and `0` for the rest;
   - the summary contains `run=1`;
   - `json()["starts"]["run"] == json!(1)`.

6. `a_run_failure_prints_its_handicaps_and_marks_in_the_report_and_the_json`. Build a `Failure` as `a_failure_names_its_start…` does, but with `start: StartKind::Run`, a real Run seed, and `decks: Box::new(GameSetup::gate(seed).decks(0))`.
   - `report(...)` contains `\n  handicaps: {` and `\n  marks: {`.
   - A `Wave` built like the one in the existing test has `json["failures"][0]["handicaps"]` and `["marks"]` non-null.
   - A non-Run failure's `handicaps` and `marks` are `null`.

7. `the_radiant_coverage_names_the_dealt_cards_no_game_resolved_on_their_radiant_face`.
   - `note_radiant` reads only `cardResolved` with `radiant: true`. Build events with `jackioh_engine::testkit::json_as::<GameEvent>(json!({"type":"cardResolved","player":"p1","instanceId":"x","defId":"core-001","permanent":false,"costPaid":1,"radiant":true}))`. The same with `false` and with no `radiant` key adds nothing.
   - `Coverage { dealt: [core-003, core-001, core-002], radiant: [core-002, fuzz-token], ..default }` gives `never_radiant() == ["core-001","core-003"]`.
     - `radiant_line()` is `"  coverage (Radiant faces): 2 of 3 dealt pool cards never resolved Radiant: core-001, core-003\n"`.
     - `json()` has `radiantResolved: 1` and `neverRadiant: ["core-001","core-003"]`.
   - `merge` unions `radiant`.
   - More than `COVERAGE_SHOWN` ids end the line with `, … (+N more)\n`.

**Existing tests to update.** Only expected values change. Change no assertion's meaning and weaken none.

- `each_start_sets_its_own_create_game_input_and_the_fold_takes_the_same`: add `StartKind::Run => (false, false, false)` to the exhaustive `match start`. `DRAWN_STARTS` excludes Run, so it never hits that arm.
- `a_failure_names_its_start_in_the_report_and_the_json_and_the_summary_counts_every_start`: the expected summary becomes `\n  starts: plain=0 dealt=0 last-boards=0 glitch-boards=1 run=0\n`. The expected JSON gains `"run": 0`.
- `the_summary_line_and_the_json_count_the_dealt_cards_never_played_sorted_by_id`: its first `assert_eq!(coverage.json(), …)` gains `"radiantResolved": 0` and `"neverRadiant": ["core-001","core-002","core-003"]`.
- The four `GameRun { … played: IndexSet::new(), }` literals in tests (around lines 3405, 3438, 5001, 5050) each gain `radiant: IndexSet::new(),`.

## Done when

- [ ] `StartKind::Run` is drawn on `RUN_START_SHARE` of seeds from `run-start-`, checked first. Seeds outside it start and deal exactly as before (tests 1 and 2).

  - If it is a real bug, do not hide it. Don't skip the seed, lower `RUN_START_SHARE`, add to `POOL_EXCLUSIONS` or use `#[ignore]`.
  - Don't fix `crates/engine`, `crates/cards` or `crates/ai` here, since that is hard-tier work. Finish the rest, name the seed, wave, stage and message in the final message, and leave the check red.
- **Pinned seeds.**
  - `r679_seed_4679_whose_glitch_voids_the_match_passes` is unaffected: 4679 is not a Run seed in the handicapped wave.
  - Gate seed 7 and seeds 6 and 14 are Run seeds. Tests that only read stream names or `handicaps()` are unaffected.
  - Tests that plant a card and play seeds `1..=20` now meet a few Run seeds. If one fails, look at that seed before touching the test.
- **Determinism and replay.**
  - `create_options` draws from fresh `Rng`s each call, so `fold_args` and the checkpoint rebuild the same game. Keep the draw order exactly as in step 7.
  - Every Run seat has an explicit handicap, so `standard_deck_size` (R1705003) never changes with the deck's length.

  - Decision: Run is a fifth `StartKind`, so a Run seed has no `dealt`, `lastBoards` or `glitchBoards`, as in a dungeon fight.
  - Rejected: stacking a run start on the old start, which would also fuzz the Glitch reset re-dealing marked Buffs (R2702000) through `glitchBoards`.
  - A Glitch reset in a Run seed still re-deals its marks, because the opening record keeps them. That path is still reachable.
  - Cost of the choice: the roughly 7% of seeds that used to draw Dealt, Last-boards or Glitch-boards in the share now play Run instead.
- **The Radiant coverage is a second line, `coverage (Radiant faces):`, not a longer first line.**
  - Rejected: lengthening the `coverage:` line. The existing line's tests and the JSON shape assert it exactly.
  - The issue says "the coverage line", so I read it as the coverage block.
- **Run decks are re-dealt from `FUZZ_POOL`**, not the wave's dealt decks resized.
  - The two decks may share a card, as a run's human and enemy decks can.
  - Rejected: truncating or extending the wave's decks. That has to protect forced cards and the handicapped seat's 30 or 35 cards.
- **The handicapped wave's rotation still applies on its seat.** The run's changes are layered on top, and the failure still names the tier and seat. Rejected: replacing the rotation with a run-only handicap.
- **Both seats draw the same kinds of change** (health, Armor, opening cards, crystals, marks). The issue says "either side".
- **Constants are strawmen** (`RUN_START_SHARE` 0.15, `RUN_START_MARK_CHANCE` 0.3, `RUN_START_BUFFS_MAX` 3), as the issue's strawman says. Tuning them is a person's call.
- **No ruling.** This is a tool change, not a rules decision.
